experiments.guard: NEW: test_defeat_shapes_file_headings_are_well_formed_and_match_their_filename — a shape file's H2 heading must match '## N. Title' (WITH the period) and N must match the filename's leading number. A heading that loses its period is invisible to the catalog scan in test_defeat_shapes_catalog_documents_every_seeded_shape (re.split(r"^## \\d+\\. ", ...) drops the whole file silently, and a sequential-numbering assertion can't see the gap either since the malformed heading was never counted as a section). This orphaned three shapes on cmx-279's own hand-resolved merge conflict.

experiments.guard: NEW: test_defeat_shapes_cross_references_resolve_to_shapes_that_exist — every 'shape N' / '[[N|...]]' cross-reference inside docs/defeat_shapes/*.md must resolve to a shape file that actually exists.
